signature: SUBROUTINE DGETRS( TRANS, N, NRHS, A, LDA, IPIV, B, LDB, INFO )

params.name: trans
params.reference:
Specifies the form of the system of equations:

-   `= 'N'`: $A \, X = B$  (No transpose)
-   `= 'T'`: $A^T \, X = B$  (Transpose)
-   `= 'C'`: $A^T \, X = B$  (Conjugate transpose = Transpose)

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: nrhs
params.reference: The number of right hand sides, i.e., the number of columns of the matrix B. $\mathrm{NRHS} \ge 0$.

params.name: A
params.reference: The factors L and U from the factorization $A = P \, L \, U$ as computed by DGETRF.

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: IPIV
params.reference: The pivot indices from DGETRF; for $1 \le i \le N$, row i of the matrix was interchanged with row `IPIV(i)`.

params.name: B
params.reference: On entry, the right hand side matrix B. On exit, the solution matrix X.

params.name: ldb
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array B. $\mathrm{LDB} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value
